requirement.original: 除了供拖拽的sidebar，其他地方的设计要和现在的固定页面notion风格travel plan一模一样
requirement.clarified: All areas of the web editor except #pane-candidates (the draggable candidates sidebar) must be visually identical to the published Notion-style travel plan page (published-page-desktop.png). Changes are driven by an authoritative UI-specialist component-level gap analysis supplied by the user.
requirement.what: CSS token corrections, structural CSS changes (remove blue border-top on middle pane), days panel redesign, tab bar redesign, day H2 heading injection in JS renderTimeline(), slot emoji labels via new helper, slot gap/padding/card shell updates.
requirement.why: The published static plan page is the design reference. The web editor must match it for visual coherence. The draggable candidates sidebar is exempted because it serves a different interaction purpose.

included: Day H2 heading in timeline (new JS rendering)
Slot title emoji prefix (new JS constant + helper)
Slot section gap (margin-based instead of gap)
Pane-candidates token isolation override (required side effect of global token change)
excluded: Mobile layout (except two specific fixes: stale border-top override and tab-content mobile padding)

success_criteria: All 16 ACs pass via DevTools computed style inspection at desktop 1440x900
Day H2 heading renders with correct format and updates on day change (AC10, AC11)
Emoji prefix appears in timeline slot titles but not in candidates sidebar group titles (AC12, AC13)
constraints: Do not modify SLOT_LABELS (shared with candidates sidebar)
Date parsing must be UTC-safe (no naive new Date(isoString))
Gap between slots must use margin-top not container gap (to avoid compounding with day-heading margin)
Hover rule on day-row must exclude active state via :not(.day-row--active)

root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: The delta produces a visually inconsistent experience where the editor looks Notion-inspired but not Notion-matched.

development_approach.strategy: Pure CSS token/rule updates plus minimal JS additions. No architectural changes. No HTML changes. Two-pass approach: (1) CSS changes in main.css top-to-bottom; (2) JS additions in state.js (new constant, new helper, heading injection).
development_approach.validation_approach: QA verifies 16 ACs via DevTools computed style at 1440x900. Key checks: AC2 (candidates sidebar isolation), AC6 (hover not overriding active), AC7 (no blue border-top), AC10/AC11 (day heading content and update), AC12/AC13 (emoji in timeline but not candidates).

codex_consult.feedback_summary: Codex identified 13 findings. 4 are implementation blockers incorporated into the spec (CSS token bleed into candidates, hover/active specificity conflict, mobile tab-content padding missing, UTC date parsing bug). 3 are structural improvements adopted (stale mobile border-top override, gap compounding with day-heading, slot-header vs slot-title separator placement, SLOT_LABELS mutation risk). Remaining findings are observations or low-risk notes.

findings.proposed_fix: Add .pane-candidates override block restoring old token values
findings.rationale: Codex finding 1 — added as R2 and AC2; candidates isolation is a hard requirement
Codex finding 2 — added as edge case 2 and wired into R6 Technical Hints item 6

findings.issue: .day-title class shared by day-row span and typography rule — changing font-size affects both
findings.rationale: Codex finding 3 — safe as-is since only one usage exists (state.js:692); change is intentional (both should be 13px)

findings.issue: Changing base .tab-content padding to 0 48px 48px without mobile override reverts mobile layout
findings.rationale: Codex finding 4 — added as R7 and AC8 with mobile override requirement

findings.issue: Removing .pane-middle border-top leaves stale mobile border-top-width: 4px override at main.css:494
findings.rationale: Codex finding 5 — added as R5 and Technical Hints item 10; pre_existing_guards entry added with removal_authorized: true

findings.issue: new Date('2026-06-20') parses as UTC midnight, renders as prior day in non-UTC timezones
findings.proposed_fix: Use regex + Date.UTC() + Intl.DateTimeFormat with timeZone: 'UTC'
findings.rationale: Codex finding 6 — _formatDayHeadingDate() helper specified in Technical Hints JS changes item 3
Codex finding 7 — confirmed present in all v2 day JSON files; noted in context dependencies

findings.issue: Render order: H2 before transport callout matches intended visual order
findings.rationale: Codex finding 8 — no conflict; heading appended before callout as specified

findings.issue: .day-heading inside .timeline-slots means container gap applies above heading too, compounding with heading margin
findings.proposed_fix: Set gap: 0 on .timeline-slots; use margin-top: 32px on .slot + .slot; keep .day-heading margin: 0 0 24px 0
findings.rationale: Codex finding 9 — R10 updated to margin-based gap; AC14 tests margin-top on .slot + .slot

findings.issue: Modifying SLOT_LABELS contaminates candidates sidebar group titles with emoji
findings.proposed_fix: Use separate SLOT_TITLE_EMOJI constant + _timelineSlotLabel() helper, used only in _buildSlotNode()
findings.rationale: Codex finding 10 — R9 redesigned to use separate constant; AC13 verifies no emoji in candidates

findings.issue: .slot-title declared twice; border-bottom on .slot-title draws only under text, not full header width
findings.rationale: Codex finding 11 — Technical Hints items 16 and 17 updated accordingly

findings.issue: Tab font-size 13px to 14px — low layout risk with two tabs
findings.rationale: Codex finding 12 — confirmed safe, no action needed

findings.proposed_fix: Use padding: 14px or --slot-padding: 14px for single component use
findings.rationale: Codex finding 13 — R14 (Should Have) covers optional token addition

codex_consult.feedback_incorporated: 5 blockers resolved (candidates token isolation, hover/active specificity, mobile tab-content padding, UTC date parsing, slot gap compounding + SLOT_LABELS contamination). 2 structural improvements adopted (stale mobile border-top removal, slot-header separator placement). All OBSERVATION_ONLY findings logged without action.
